interpretation.failure: Either residual logical parity after the common final decoder.
interpretation.pairing: Three outcomes replay the same original fault record; the eight-bin histogram preserves all pairwise contrasts.
interpretation.seed: X uses an ideal encoded seed. Z applies the same full r=0 seed repair in every arm, retaining seed logical errors.
interpretation.two_slice_x: With ideal idles, the logical X outcome is fixed after the first corrected two-slice window; this is preparation damage, not a noisy-memory threshold along T.
interpretation.intervals: Marginals use pointwise 95% Wilson intervals. Paired differences use approximate pointwise 95% Bonferroni-Wilson intervals for discordant counts; no simultaneous grid coverage is claimed.
interpretation.threshold_differences: The fitted thresholds are correlated. Do not infer threshold differences from independent marginal confidence intervals.
interpretation.incomplete: No fit is attempted until every frozen point reaches the selected shot target.
